subject: Post-discovery: Align on evaluation kickoff & mutual action plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@careloop.com>, Priya Desai <priya@careloop.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Nov 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery recap + options for evaluation kickoff

Hi Sanjay & Priya,

Thanks again for the discovery call today — really helpful to understand CareLoop's triage and intake bottlenecks, and how accuracy at the categorization + reranking edge could shave off clinician triage time. Quick recap of what I heard: 

- Primary goal: reduce manual triage time by 30% and improve classification precision for high-priority cases.
- Key constraints: PHI-sensitive flows, must run in VPC/on-prem for certain cohorts, timeline: pilot in Q1.
- Success criteria you mentioned: 30% reduction in triage workload, >= 92% precision on priority labels in the pilot data window.

Next step suggestion: schedule the evaluation kickoff (technical deep dive + pilot plan). We typically structure that call as: 
- 30m technical/architecture alignment (network, VPC & KMS, data flow)
- 30m pilot plan (prompt set, eval metrics, acceptance criteria, sample data requirements)

Proposed slots (Pacific time):
- Mon 6 Nov, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Tue 7 Nov, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Wed 8 Nov, 08:30–09:30 PT

If none of those work, tell me preferred windows and we’ll re-run. I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with an initial timeline and ownerships to speed alignment — please review before the kickoff if possible. Also, a heads-up: we’ll surface a short security questionnaire ahead of the technical deep dive; if your security team prefers to kick that off earlier we can share it now.

Next steps I’ll take once you confirm a slot: send calendar invite with agenda, include a short prep pack (sample prompt set template + data checklist), and loop in a solutions engineer.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147

Attachment: MAP-CareLoop-2028-11-01.pdf (1 page — draft mutual action plan)

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@careloop.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@careloop.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Nov 2028 17:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery recap + options for evaluation kickoff

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. That matches our notes.

Tue 7 Nov, 14:00 PT works best for our team (Sanjay + Priya). Can you include a high-level agenda and any specific security items we should prepare?

Also: our procurement lead wants to understand expected infra footprint for the pilot (rough GPU type / hours) — can you surface a ballpark so we can prep budget/ops?

One more ask: please send the security questionnaire now if it’s short; otherwise we’ll need it before the tech deep dive.

—Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
VP Product, CareLoop Health
sanjay@careloop.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@careloop.com>, Priya Desai <priya@careloop.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Nov 2028 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery recap + options for evaluation kickoff

Thanks Sanjay — confirmed for Tue, 7 Nov 2028 at 14:00 PT. Calendar invite sent separately.

Quick notes / prep pack attached and links below:

Agenda (45–60m):
- 10m Introductions & goals recap
- 20m Technical deep dive (networking, VPC / KMS, data flow, minimal infra footprint)
- 20m Pilot plan & success criteria (prompt set, eval metrics, timeline, acceptance thresholds)

Prep items for CareLoop:
- Short sample of 500 labeled records (de-identified) or a schema + example records if you can’t share samples yet
- Point of contact for security/procurement (we’ll invite them to the call if available)

Security questionnaire attached (PDF stub) — that covers our standard baseline items (data residency, encryption at rest/in transit, access controls). We’ll also prepare a ballpark infra estimate for the pilot (typical pilot uses 1–2 mid-size GPUs for 4–6 weeks; we’ll include concrete numbers during the deep dive).

Links / files: 
- MAP draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bCareLoopMAP
- Security questionnaire: CareLoop-security-asks.pdf (attached)
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DA-2028-019

If there’s someone from procurement/security who should be copied now, please reply-all with their contact and we’ll add them.

See you on the 7th — Marissa will run the technical portion; I’ll cover pilot success criteria.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: CareLoop-security-asks.pdf (2 pages), MAP-CareLoop-2028-11-01.pdf
